items.name: Bananas  Super Rare  Character Mastery
items.reference_observation: Official Hit-Monkey GIF verified: thick gold crescents with inner ridge, dark tips and freckles; ten exterior motion fits over 69 frames/4.610s. Two six-frame glyph tracks compared against actual WebGL captures with pose/length matching; other ten frames give mean silhouette F1 0.648 baseline vs 0.776 current. Full game cycle, emitter distribution and all-angle fidelity remain unverified.
items.additional_reference_observation: Official MarvelSnap 720p/60fps walkthrough downloaded and played; 142 sampled frames registered across a continuous Infinaut Prism/Bananas shot. Cost/power badges excluded. Nine exterior local-motion candidates provide a second check, but frame/badge crossings censor tracks; visible spans are not full particle lifetimes. This shot has not been used for full-cycle acceptance or further production parameter changes.

items.observed_motion: v89: independent constant sizes, upward motion from chosen contour, normal alpha blend and exterior fade; WebGL/Godot shared surface and SDK sampler checks passed. Density, complete cycle, emitter distributions and all views remain unverified.

items.name: BorderCandyCane_Halloween sample Candy Cane · Orange Oct 27, 2025
items.reference_observation: 2026-10-13: inspected 76-frame/2.25-second public preview. Implemented fixed purple/orange diagonal bands, correctly oriented cylindrical shading and bounded purple outer light. 11 WebGL captures and 18-palette Godot GPU regression pass. Registration and full-game motion still require calibration.

items.name: BorderStickerHalloween sample Border Sticker Halloween · Green Oct 27, 2025
items.reference_observation: 2026-10-13: v71 calibrates the top spider with curved legs, head peaks, slower horizontal travel, angle-coupled projection/orbit/light and front/back ordering behind other top decorations. Both versions use the corrected 75 x 30 ms reference clock and one fixed registration. All-75 top bright IoU .289259 to .300373 and RGB error 44.516 to 43.130; 11 frames regress. The 61 visually unreviewed frames are not a blind holdout because numeric scores informed iteration. Three earlier candidates are retained, including the rejected fixed-front composition. Left moon/rail unchanged; non-top differences are 0-2 pixels at one channel unit. WebGL and Godot regression evidence is linked; full in-game loop, all shapes and material remain unverified, not accepted 1:1.
